title: still present since round 4: EXEMPT_ARMS trusts comments over code for 17 arms — removing a claimed-unreachable arm's guard keeps the lint green
evidence:
# Message arms whose real api calls are structurally unreachable in demo mode
# (auth flows always exit the demo first; ApiReturnedSession/PolicyRefresh are
# demo-guarded at the top of their handlers).
EXEMPT_ARMS = {
    "ApiReturnedLogin",
    "UserSubmittedLogin",
    ...
    "UserAcceptedPolicy",
    "ApiReturnedAcceptPolicy",' — a bare string set consumed as `if scope_name in EXEMPT_ARMS: continue`; no mechanical verification backs the unreachability claims (unlike DEMO_INTERCEPTED/FN_INTERCEPTED_TRIGGERS, which are manifest-checked).
detail: The r4-B1 fix mechanised the interception manifests but left EXEMPT_ARMS comment-trusted: an auth arm gaining a demo-reachable path (e.g. UserAcceptedPolicy after a policy bump) passes the lint vacuously.
recommended_fix: Verify each EXEMPT_ARMS claim mechanically (e.g. its request trigger must be intercepted or the arm must carry its own demo guard).
